setup_compiler_build: excluded from production per-case search cost
finalist_work: finalists phase includes four candidate compiles, actual occupancy, and required repricing/recompilation; phase elapsed includes guard waits
extra_E_work: audit-only; excluded from normal production search cost
CPU_build_optimization: Search used the initial CPU build; materialization used Release from the same HEAD. Original receipts and generated-code equivalence proof are retained. Search time is the actual initial run, not an inferred optimized time.
finalist_compile_work_note: Sum of per-command wall durations, including host generation and compile queue time; work sum is not parallel elapsed wall time.
audit_resume_gap_note: The initial audit process stopped before its end receipt. Accepted process results were reused. The recorded resumed phase duration excludes the interrupted interval.
audit_CPU_worker_note: Initial two-worker dispatch paused until child builds completed, then resumed with four compilation workers; completed immutable artifacts were recovered without rebuilding.
